t: 纳布卢斯议会举行,确立了耶路撒冷十字军王国最早幸存的成文法.
te: The Council of Nablus is held, establishing the earliest surviving written laws of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.
dz: 十字军:纳布卢斯议会举行,确立了耶路撒冷十字军王国最早幸存的成文法.
de: Crusades: The Council of Nablus is held, establishing the earliest surviving written laws of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.

t: 卡普亚的理查克三世被授以"王子"的称号,在他不适时地去世两周前.
te: Richard III of Capua is anointed as Prince two weeks before his untimely death.
dz: 卡普亚的理查克三世被授以"王子"的称号,在他不适时地去世两周前.
de: Richard III of Capua is anointed as Prince two weeks before his untimely death.

t: 卡普亚的乔丹二世被他幼子外甥死后被授为王子.
te: Jordan II of Capua is anointed as prince after his infant nephew's death.
dz: 卡普亚的乔丹二世被他幼子外甥死后被授为王子.
de: Jordan II of Capua is anointed as prince after his infant nephew's death.

t: 白船沉入英吉利海峡,淹死了英国亨利一世之子和继承人威廉·阿德林.
te: The White Ship sinks in the English Channel, drowning William Adelin, son and heir of Henry I of England.
dz: 白船沉入英吉利海峡,淹死了英国亨利一世之子和继承人威廉·阿德林.
de: The White Ship sinks in the English Channel, drowning William Adelin, son and heir of Henry I of England.
